item.title: Getting Down with the Leploop (V3)
item.description: video upload by InfinD "The Leploop is an analog 'groove box', with two oscillator, a percussion voice, four independent sequencer tracks and pretty wild filter. Really it's all you need for a live techno set, but it has plenty of ins and outs to connect with other gizmos. Keeping it simple here, I have it clock synced to the Korg NTS-1 MKII, providing a ping-pong delay and some backing rhythm
